description: Capability for the call indicator window (label `call-indicator`, created and destroyed only by the indicator thread, src-tauri/src/call_indicator.rs): listen to and stop listening to indicator://state and indicator://tick, invoke the app commands call_indicator_stop, call_indicator_dismiss, call_indicator_moved and call_indicator_state, and start dragging its own window. Nothing else (T-130; least privilege, decision #45; app commands are ACL-checked per label, T-049, docs/decisions/ipc-acl.md).
